c:
Thank you for contacting us. If you are unable to transfer your character to another server, it may be due to one of the following reasons. Please check each one:

1. Transfer hours: Server Transfers are only available during two daily windows that depend on your region. Outside of these hours, transfers will appear as unavailable. The exact hours are shown on the Server Transfer page in the in-game Shop.
2. Transfer period: Server Transfers are only available during the announced period. Early Access servers could transfer from October 14 to 21, and Launch servers can transfer from October 21 until the maintenance on October 28.
3. Server type: Early Access servers can only transfer to other Early Access servers, and Launch servers can only transfer to other Launch servers. Transfers must also stay within the same faction and region.
4. Server capacity: Each server has a limit on transfers in and out, which is updated every hour. If your current server or the destination server has reached its limit, the transfer will not be possible. Please try again in a later window.
5. Character requirements: The character must be level 10 or higher, be standing in a village, not be in a Legion (and have no pending Legion application), and have no active Duty Missions.
6. Pending items: You must have no items listed on the Market, no items or proceeds waiting to be collected, no unclaimed items in Shop Storage (including the Founder's Pack), and no unclaimed mail on the character.
7. One transfer per account: Each account can only perform one server transfer during the transfer period.
8. Character slots: The destination server must have enough free character slots for the characters you are moving. Extra slots can be purchased for 1,000 Quna each.

If the issue persists after checking all of the above, please let us know your current server, the destination server, and send us a screenshot of the message you see.
m:
Issue: The user cannot transfer to another server.
Resolution: Provided the user with the possible reasons and requirements for server transfer.

c:
Unfortunately, Player Support is unable to grant extra server transfers, nor can we reverse a server transfer once it has been completed. Additionally, we cannot manually move characters or items between servers. We understand this is likely disappointing news, but these actions are outside what our team can assist with.

However, NCSoft plans to make server transfer vouchers available for purchase in the in-game Shop soon. While we do not have an exact release date to share just yet, this will offer an alternative option if you decide to transfer your character to another server in the future. 

Thank you for your understanding and patience.
m:
Issue: User wants to undo server transfer.
Resolution: Explained this is not possible, but that it will be possible to purchase additional vouchers soon.

c:
I completely understand your frustration regarding this situation. Unfortunately, it is impossible to transfer items between servers right now. This is not for a lack of wanting to help, but rather due to technical limitations. 

However, please know that your items are not lost. You will be able to retrieve them soon, once NCSOFT makes additional server transfer vouchers available (yes, there are official plans in progress for this). 

When that happens, you will be able to create a character on the old server, take the items out of the server storage, and transfer that character along with the items to your new server.

Please try the following steps to locate your missing Splendent Ruby:

Open your character's storage and check the Miscellaneous category. The Splendent Ruby may have been moved there instead of remaining in your inventory.

If you find it, move it back to your inventory and try speaking to the quest NPC again.

If you still can't find it, try sorting your storage and checking the other categories as well.

Some players experiencing the same issue have reported finding the missing item in their storage.

Thanks for the detailed explanation!

The Remaining Unobtained Cube Count is shared across Conquest and Transcendence dungeons on the same server. Opening a reward cube does not consume this allowance. However, completing a dungeon and leaving without claiming its cube rewards can reduce the count, even if you opened other cubes during the same run.

Since Fire Temple can provide multiple reward cubes per run, could you clarify whether you left any cubes unopened in both runs, or only in one of them?

If you left a cube unopened in each run, the decrease from 2 to 0 would be consistent with this mechanic. If you left rewards unclaimed in only one run, we would need to investigate further to understand why the count decreased twice.

Thank you for reaching out, and we understand how frustrating this can be, especially if you were planning to transfer soon.

The minimum character level required for a server transfer was recently updated and is now level 45. Characters below this level can't be transferred. Once your character reaches level 45, you'll be able to transfer, as long as you meet the other transfer requirements, such as the destination server not being full.

However, I've noted your feedback and passed it along to the team, so they know there's demand to return to the previous requirement. We can't confirm whether this will change, but your feedback helps show how players feel about it.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
m:
Issue: Player was unable to transfer servers because their character was below the new minimum level requirement.
Resolution: Informed the player that the minimum level for server transfers is now 45. Player's feedback was noted and forwarded to the team, along with the demand to return to the previous requirement.

c:
¡Hola! Gracias por ponerte en contacto con nosotros. Entendemos perfectamente lo frustrante que puede ser esta situación, sobre todo si tenías planeado cambiar de servidor pronto. 

Hace poco se actualizó el nivel mínimo requerido para la transferencia de servidor y ahora es el nivel 45. Lamentablemente, los personajes con un nivel inferior no se pueden transferir. En cuanto tu personaje alcance el nivel 45, podrás realizar el cambio sin problemas, siempre y cuando cumplas con el resto de los requisitos (como que el servidor de destino no esté lleno). 

De todos modos, ya tomé nota de tus comentarios y se los pasé al equipo para que sepan que hay interés en volver al límite anterior. No te puedo confirmar si esto cambiará en el futuro, pero tu opinión nos ayuda muchísimo a entender cómo se siente la comunidad. 

Muchas gracias por tu paciencia y comprensión.
